description: This file is a header (.h) file for the Device_IP_Diagnostics_UDPEchoConfig module in a TR-069 device management context. It declares APIs for setting UDP Echo configuration parameters, such as enabling UDP Echo, interface path, and UDP port, related to IP diagnostics.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_UDPEchoConfig_Enable
methods.description: Sets the enable flag for UDP Echo, allowing the device to perform UDP Echo services.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_UDPEchoConfig_Interface
methods.description: Sets the IP-layer interface over which the device listens for UDP echo requests.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_UDPEchoConfig_UDPPort
methods.description: Sets the UDP port number on which the device listens for UDP echo requests.
